description: A structure in the language \(\{0,S\}\) satisfies the infinitary successor sentence if and only if it is isomorphic to the standard natural-number successor structure.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.successor_categorical.{w} (M : Type w)
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.successorLanguage.Structure M] :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.successorSentence.Realize M ↔
    Nonempty (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.successorLanguage.Equiv ℕ M)
